Name: Winter with Maru (Beta)
Author: megmom84
Description:
I made this outfit to go with the Longevity Mod's Dynamic NPCs, to use in the Winter when she is outdoors.

If you want to just use her in your game, put this new .xnb file in place of the Maru.xnb in your Characters folder in your Stardew Valley folder, or in your XNBLoader Characters folder if you use that mod.

If you want to use it with Longevity you'll have to rename it properly to take the place of the file you get with that mod. I'll check and see if the maker of that mod wants to use it for future versions of Longevity as an alternate option for those who prefer the Beta version of Maru like I do. I haven't tinkered with character portraits yet, unfortunately, but I'll try to work on that next.

Thank you to those who download and I hope you enjoy this.
